paper_metadata.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: We present Kimi-VL, an efficient open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language model (VLM) that offers advanced multimodal reasoning, long-context understanding, and strong agent capabilities - all while activating only 2.8B parameters in its language decoder (Kimi-VL-A3B). Kimi-VL demonstrates strong performance across challenging domains: as a general-purpose VLM, Kimi-VL excels in multi-turn agent tasks (e.g., OSWorld), matching flagship models. Furthermore, it exhibits remarkable capabilities across diverse challenging vision language tasks, including college-level image and video comprehension, OCR, mathematical reasoning, and multi-image understanding. In comparative evaluations, it effectively competes with cutting-edge efficient VLMs such as GPT-4o-mini, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Gemma-3-12B-IT, while surpassing GPT-4o in several key domains. Kimi-VL also advances in processing long contexts and perceiving clearly. With a 128K extended context window, Kimi-VL can process diverse long inputs, achieving impressive scores of 64.5 on LongVideoBench and 35.1 on MMLongBench-Doc. Its native-resolution vision encoder, MoonViT, further allows it to see and understand ultra-high-resolution visual inputs, achieving 83.2 on InfoVQA and 34.5 on ScreenSpot-Pro, while maintaining lower computational cost for common tasks. Building upon Kimi-VL, we introduce an advanced long-thinking variant: Kimi-VL-Thinking-2506. Developed through long chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), the latest model exhibits strong long-horizon reasoning capabilities (64.0 on MMMU, 46.3 on MMMU-Pro, 56.9 on MathVision, 80.1 on MathVista, 65.2 on VideoMMMU) while obtaining robust general abilities. Code and models are publicly accessible at https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-VL.

extraction_data.innovation: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language model with only 2.8B activated parameters in its language decoder; native-resolution MoonViT vision encoder for ultra-high-resolution visual inputs; 128K extended context window; efficient open-source VLM for advanced multimodal reasoning, long-context understanding, and strong agent capabilities.
extraction_data.research_problem: Open-source VLMs lagging in scalability, computational efficiency, and advanced reasoning; need for efficient MoE VLM with long-thinking and native-resolution vision.
extraction_data.application: Multimodal reasoning, long-context understanding, agent tasks (OSWorld), college-level image/video comprehension, OCR, mathematical reasoning, multi-image understanding.
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training on web data -> instruction tuning
extraction_data.moe_configuration: 16B total parameters, 2.8B activated parameters in language decoder
extraction_data.benchmark_result: LongVideoBench: 64.5; MMLongBench-Doc: 35.1; InfoVQA: 83.2; ScreenSpot-Pro: 34.5; MMMU (val): 57; MMBench-EN-v1.1: 83.2; BLINK: 57.3; OCR: 83.1; Multi-Image: 58.6; Long Video: 64.5; Long Doc: 35.1; Agent: 8.2 (OSWorld)

extraction_data.innovation: Advanced long-thinking variant developed through long chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL); exhibits strong long-horizon reasoning capabilities with ~3B activated parameters.
extraction_data.application: Long-horizon reasoning, multimodal reasoning, general abilities.
extraction_data.research_problem: Advanced multimodal reasoning and long-horizon thinking in efficient open-source VLMs.
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL)
extraction_data.benchmark_result: MMMU: 64.0; MMMU-Pro: 46.3; MathVision: 56.9; MathVista: 80.1; VideoMMMU: 65.2; MMBench: 84.4; V*: 83.2; ScreenSpot-Pro: 52.8

extraction_data.innovation: MoE-based architecture for scalable efficiency; native-resolution vision encoder (MoonViT) for high-resolution visual tasks; 128K extended context window; hybrid mix of reasoning and non-reasoning data with explicit mode tokens to enable both fast direct answers and chain-of-thought reasoning.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: 5.2T pure text tokens, 2.3T joint multimodal/text tokens, 1.4T long-context, 0.6T long-text/video/doc, 0.3T pure text
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Visual instruction tuning, long-CoT supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, Post-training with reasoning and non-reasoning data mix
extraction_data.extension: Native-resolution MoonViT encoder; 128K context window extension.
extraction_data.research_problem: Multimodal reasoning, long-context understanding, and high-resolution visual perception.
extraction_data.application: Multimodal reasoning, video understanding, long-context document understanding, OS grounding, visual perception.
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Seed dataset for non-reasoning tasks, rejection-sampled reasoning data, long-CoT data synthesized via Kimi k1.5
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Text pre-training -> Joint multimodal pre-training -> Joint cooldown -> Joint long-context -> Pure text re-warmup -> Reinforcement Learning (RL) -> Continued training on MoonViT
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Rejection sampling and prompt engineering to sample multiple detailed reasoning trajectories using Kimi k1.5, filtered by an off-the-shelf reward model and rule-based rewards
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Off-the-shelf reward model and rule-based rewards
extraction_data.vision_encoder: MoonViT (native-resolution, initialized from SigLIP-SO-400M, extended to 3.2M pixels), MoonViT (native-resolution encoder)
extraction_data.benchmark_result: MMMU: 57.0; College-level: 52.6; MMVU: 52.2; MMBench-EN-v1.1: 83.1; MMStar: 61.3; General RealWorldQA: 66.7; AI2D: 84.9; Multi-image BLINK: 57.3; Math: 21.4; InfoVQA: 83.2; OCRBench: 867; ScreenSpot-V2: 92.8; ScreenSpot-Pro: 34.5; OSAgent: 10.4; LongDocument MMLongBench-Doc: 35.1; Video-MME: 7; MathVision: 56.9%; MathVista: 80.1%; MMMU-Pro: 46.3%; MMMU: 64.0%; MMBench-EN-v1.1: 84.4%; MMStar: 70.0%; RealWorldQA: 70.0%; MMVet: 78.4%; VideoMMMU: 65.2%; Video-MME: 71.9%; MMLongBench-Doc: 42.1%; V*Benchmark: 83.2%; ScreenSpot-Pro: 52.8%; OSWorld-G: 52.5%
